Logan — quick pass below, pasted into the PDF with inline comments (attached). High-level: I like the narrative flow but recommend we tighten the metrics and call out the two customer wins in the first half of the year more clearly.

Inline notes (summary):
- Page 1: Replace the stacked KPI table with two compact KPI tiles (MRR growth; daily active inference keys). The table overloads the page.
- Page 2 (Risk matrix): Add a row for "Open-source model shifts" with mitigation notes (quantization playbook + fallback routing).
- Page 3 (Asks): Reword the Dedicated discount ask to be customer-facing: "Contract credits tied to committed throughput." Avoid mentioning internal pricing floors.

Attachment: [Attachment: Q4_exec_one_pager_v2_comments.pdf (pdf)]

-Laura

- Shortened the customer win blurbs to single-sentence bullets.
- Rewrote Dedicated ask to: "Request authorization for customer credits tied to 12-month committed throughput; finance to provide guardrails for approval."

Marissa — can you confirm investor outreach cadence if we lock tomorrow morning? If we want the board packet to include the one-pager, I recommend circulating to boardsec and IR on Friday morning with a 4pm PT pre-brief on Friday.

-Jordan
